_comment: SCENARIO 0: Temporary availability denials -- Weather.com upstream forecast provider times out transiently; works with a retry...
_expected_recovery: Agent sees upstream_timeout (potential indication that it is retryable). Retries get_hourly_forecast(loc_portland). Second call succeeds with full hourly data. Agent extracts the next 6 hours of precipitation chance and wind speed and presents them to the user. No server switch needed.
_scenario_description: Weather.com upstream forecast provider times out transiently; works with a retry.

question.content: I'm heading out for a morning run in Portland, Oregon. Give me the hourly precipitation and wind forecast for the next 6 hours so I know if I need to reroute indoors.

response_rubrics._description: Agent retries get_hourly_forecast after seeing retryable upstream_timeout and presents 6-hour precipitation and wind data
expected_response: next 6 hours of precipitation and wind forecast for Portland
hourly precipitation chance and wind speed

_expected_recovery: Agent sees feature_suspended. Switches to Yahoo Weather: resolve_location('Portland') -> woeid_portland, resolve_location('Denver') -> woeid_denver, resolve_location('Phoenix') -> woeid_phoenix. Then compare_weather(location_ids=['woeid_portland','woeid_denver','woeid_phoenix']) -> succeeds with side-by-side current conditions for all three cities.
_scenario_description: Weather.com comparative analysis feature suspended permanently; Yahoo Weather compare_weather operational.

question.content: I'm deciding between Portland, Denver, and Phoenix for a relocation. Compare the current weather conditions across all three cities side by side, including temperature, humidity, and wind.

response_rubrics._description: Agent detects feature_suspended, switches to Yahoo Weather, and presents side-by-side comparison
expected_response: side-by-side comparison of Portland, Denver, and Phoenix
temperature, humidity, and wind for all three cities
